_note: Observed series used to grade the replay. Every value was read from the cited source; none was reconstructed, interpolated or estimated. Values are stored in their ORIGINAL unit with the original reporting period; the mapping layer converts them, and never overwrites them.
_turn_mapping_rule: Week 1 begins 2021-05-25. A monthly observation is assigned to the week containing the midpoint of its reporting month (day 15). This is a lossy assignment recorded explicitly in each observation's `turn_assignment` field, not a silent resample.

observations.turn_assignment: month midpoint 2021-05-15 falls before week 1 (2021-05-25); assigned to turn 0 as the last pre-event monthly reading
observations.note: Global average delay for LATE vessel arrivals, May 2021. Published AFTER the knowledge cutoff, so it may be used for EVALUATION ONLY and must not initialise the model.

observations.turn_assignment: month midpoint 2021-06-15 falls in week 4 counting from 2021-05-25; assigned to turn 3 (zero-indexed weeks elapsed)
observations.note: Global average delay for LATE vessel arrivals, June 2021 — the month containing the bulk of the disruption.

observations.turn_assignment: month midpoint 2021-07-15 is 51 days after 2021-05-25 = week 8; assigned to turn 7
observations.note: Global average delay for LATE vessel arrivals, July 2021 — first full month after Yantian resumed full operations (24 June 2021).

observations.turn_assignment: month midpoint 2021-08-15 is 82 days after 2021-05-25 = week 12
observations.note: Global average delay for LATE vessel arrivals, August 2021. Continued deterioration well after Yantian recovered — a strong indication that this global series is dominated by causes other than Yantian.

observations.turn_assignment: pre-event context only; negative turn means it is outside the simulated window and is never scored
observations.note: The baseline used to initialise the replay. Recorded as 'context' rather than 'observed' so that the evaluation cannot score the model against its own initial condition.
April 2021. Not usable for initialisation (published after the knowledge cutoff) and not scored. Also carries a cross-release inconsistency: see source si_glp_2021_04 notes.

_not_observed.reason: No continuous weekly freight index series could be assembled from public, citable sources for May-September 2021; the full historical series are commercial products. freight_cost is therefore NOT evaluated in this replay.
